projects.title: Concurrent request initiation
projects.completeScope: Start three independent supplied fetch promises before awaiting, reject non-ok responses and return profile name/open-task count/notice count.
requiredEvidence: HTTP failure witness, distinguished from real browser traffic

projects.title: Delegated nested click
projects.completeScope: Resolve a nested click to the nearest data-action button inside the owned list, return exact task ID and action, reject outside-list/unknown-action clicks.
requiredEvidence: Actual browser click log when executed

projects.title: Bounded retry classification
projects.completeScope: Classify transport rejection and HTTP503 as retryable, HTTP404 and JSON parse errors as nonretryable; reject unknown evidence labels.
requiredEvidence: A specific Gemini claim and counterexample

limitation: The checker uses injected deferred requests and a minimal DOM interface. Genuine browser clicks/Network records are separate learner observations. This policy omits the original timeout/backoff/cleanup implementation.
